text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's Welfare Party gives a moderate Islamist picture at its congress.
- Tension in divided island of Cyprus caused the death of a Greek Cypriot civilian.
- International Monetary Fund (IMF) delegation to visit Turkey unexpectedly on Monday.
- Islamist-led government's 1997 budget plans gives signals of possible early general elections.
- Young Islamists in Welfare protest at Erbakan for taking moderate line in the party congress held on Sunday.
- The Patriotic Union of Kurdistan takes over Sulaimaniya after Kurdistan Democratic Party seized it in September.
- Tractor maker HEMA starts production after a six-year break.
- Football clubs seeks new ideas, including producing pastry and perfume, in order to raise money.
- Erbakan criticises main opposition leader Mesut Yilmaz at Welfare Party congress.
